title: Airports with no departures
statementMd:
List airports with fewer than 8 departures (zero counts). Show city and departures.

Expected columns: `city`, `departures`.

Tables: `airlines`, `airports`, `flights`, `bookings`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT a.city, COUNT(f.id) AS departures FROM airports a LEFT JOIN flights f ON f.origin = a.code GROUP BY a.code, a.city HAVING COUNT(f.id) < 8;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
